note: The audit runs with A01 open at every part of its controls (families, time, presets, palettes, seed, parameters, library with an entry, export with a made image); the standalone settings and acknowledgements screens are now the one app's and are audited by SettingsUITests.testAuditOfSettingsAndAboutAtTheDefaultTextSize
Same walk at UICTContentSizeCategoryAccessibilityXXXL; settings and acknowledgements: SettingsUITests.testAuditOfSettingsAndAboutAtTheLargestTextSize
The description of session.canvas follows family, preset, palette and play state; the one app starts A01 in the Particles family
The time controls are A01's native controls below the canvas (the standalone app showed them in a sheet)

Gradient Noise is chosen first through the family control because the one app starts A01 in Particles; the parameter and reset identifiers are A01's parameter.warp and reset.warp instead of vc.param.warp
Export is A01's Make image control (2048 by 2048 square) and Share image; the standalone size and aspect pickers, dimension text and crop preview have no counterpart in the adapter and are not ported
The gallery is now A01's family control; a shader error ends the session in session.failure (the standalone gas.scene.error); the route title replaces the home title
The launch smoke test belongs to the one app: LaunchUITests.testAFirstLaunchShowsTheWelcome; A01's title on its route is checked by GASGalleryUITests.testGalleryListsFourFamiliesAndEachOpensACanvas

Save, survive the end of the app, rename, remove with confirmation (cancel keeps it) and open an entry; the adapter lists entries by name (not newest first) and has no favourites and no duplication (they stay in the standalone app until its retirement), so those steps are not ported
The one app has no -gasComposition import: corrupt data is a damaged stored state (-vcDamageState garbage); Reset of the notice is the counterpart of Use default
Future-version data is a stored state of a newer schema (-vcDamageState newer); the notice names the newer version and Reset continues

Counterpart: a readable stored state opens without a notice and with the composition it held; there are no correction notes in the one app and the clamping of out-of-range values is covered by the adapter's core unit tests
The settings screen belongs to the one app: SettingsUITests.testTheThreeSettingsSurviveARelaunch (Reduce Motion and Reduce Flashing persist across a relaunch)
The acknowledgements belong to the one app: SettingsUITests.testAboutShowsNameVersionAndAcknowledgements

The audit runs with A02 open at a scroll stop for each section of its controls (canvas, palette, brush, motion, quality, edges, simulation detail, tuning, capture with a made picture) and paused; the standalone home and acknowledgements are the one app's and are audited by LauncherUITests.testAuditOfTheCatalogAtTheDefaultTextSize and SettingsUITests.testAuditOfSettingsAndAboutAtTheDefaultTextSize

Same walk at UICTContentSizeCategoryAccessibilityXXXL; home and acknowledgements: LauncherUITests.testAuditOfTheCatalogAtTheLargestTextSize and SettingsUITests.testAuditOfSettingsAndAboutAtTheLargestTextSize
The acknowledgements belong to the one app: SettingsUITests.testAboutShowsNameVersionAndAcknowledgements

The Adjust sheet is A02's Motion, Quality, Edges, Simulation detail and Tuning controls below the canvas (no Done button); Reset is tuningReset; the quality-tier row (fap.adjust.tier) has no counterpart because the session host sets the quality level, so it is not ported
Pause, step and reset are A02's native controls; same behaviour
The launch smoke test belongs to the one app: LaunchUITests.testAFirstLaunchShowsTheWelcome; A02's title on its route is checked by FAPPlaygroundUITests.testOpenPlaygroundShowsDescribedCanvas

Palette and brush are A02's controls below the canvas; capture offers Share picture through the session's still renderer; the standalone message Captured <size> has no counterpart (capture.message appears only on a failure) and is replaced by a check that no message appears
The standalone home's Open button is A02's catalog tile (vc.tile.a02.fluid-art-playground); leaving is the route's back control (vc.experience.back) back to the catalog
The splash control is labelled Splash (the standalone Add splash); the canvas gestures are a coordinate drag and swipeLeft, and the two-finger pinch that resizes the brush is checked too

The audit runs with A03 open at a scroll stop for each section of its controls (family, view, go to with an error, iterations and cost, palette, animation, tour caption, bookmarks with a saved view, capture with a made picture), at the Julia seed controls and with the precision notice; the standalone home and acknowledgements are the one app's and are audited by LauncherUITests.testAuditOfTheCatalogAtTheDefaultTextSize and SettingsUITests.testAuditOfSettingsAndAboutAtTheDefaultTextSize

Same walk at UICTContentSizeCategoryAccessibilityXXXL; home and acknowledgements: LauncherUITests.testAuditOfTheCatalogAtTheLargestTextSize and SettingsUITests.testAuditOfSettingsAndAboutAtTheLargestTextSize
The acknowledgements belong to the one app: SettingsUITests.testAboutShowsNameVersionAndAcknowledgements

Save with a name, survive the end of the app (the experience's storage replaces -uitestTemporaryBookmarks), open after the view changed, rename, remove with confirmation (cancel keeps it); rename and remove are row buttons instead of swipe actions and the empty state is no row (no sentence); the adapter keeps no favourites (they stay in the standalone app until its retirement), so the favourite step is not ported
Go to is A03's section of controls (no sheet); the error names the field as Real (Real: Use a value between −4 and 4) instead of Real part; a valid entry gives the same spoken description

The cap is a number with Halve and Double buttons (no slider) spoken as <n> iterations; the cost line is the same; capture offers Share picture through the session's still renderer, and the standalone message Captured at <size> has no counterpart (capture.message appears only when limited or failed), so the port checks that no failure appears
Tours are A03's controls (no sheet); the tour advances by the core's fixed steps, so the caption wait is longer; Stop ends the tour and keeps the caption as before
The segmented mode control is A03's Family choices (mode.mandelbrot and mode.julia); explanation, seed line and spoken canvas description are the same

Zoom, reset, palette choices (no menu) and the animation toggle are A03's controls; the precision limit uses fixed constants, so the separate near-limit notice, the shader-precision source line and the limit suffix of the canvas description have no counterpart and are not ported; the limit notice and the stopped zoom are checked; canvas drag and pinch are checked too
The launch smoke test belongs to the one app: LaunchUITests.testAFirstLaunchShowsTheWelcome; A03's title on its route is checked by FEExplorerUITests.testOpenFromTheCatalogShowsTheDescribedCanvas
